subject: Fuel surcharge schedule update - December 2026
text:
Customers,

Based on the DOE national average diesel price, Cobalt Freight's fuel surcharge for December 2026 will be 31.5 percent of linehaul for truckload and 24.0 percent for LTL, up from 29.0 and 22.5 percent in November. The updated table is attached and is also posted in the shipper portal.

Accessorial rates (detention, layover, TONU) are unchanged.

Thank you,
Cobalt Freight Pricing
